description: This file defines the ITransactionManager interface and the AccessCounter struct within the Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions namespace, specifying transaction management operations and data structures for transactions.

classes.name: AccessCounter
classes.description: Represents counts of read and write accesses performed by a transaction participant; supports addition operation.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Requests the transaction manager to prepare and commit a transaction, returning its status.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Notifies the transaction manager of a participant's prepare outcome.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a keep-alive message to indicate a participant is still waiting on transaction outcome.
